Chinese handwriting recognition — trial

HKIME uses hanzi_lookup by Gábor Ugray, derived from Jordan Kiang’s HanziLookup. Library: GNU LGPL v3. Stroke data derived from Make Me a Hanzi / Arphic fonts: Arphic Public License. No warranty. Candidates are engine results only; no answer keys are sent to the recognizer. No automatic traditional/simplified conversion.

Upstream revision: 01f90c3ab99a8fadf0696c28e5eb097223c500db. The upstream JavaScript and WebAssembly are distributed unmodified as separate files. The worker adapter is HKIME integration code.

Replacing / rebuilding the library

Extract source.tar.gz, follow README-upstream.md and build_wasm.cmd (Rust nightly with wasm32-unknown-unknown target; cargo build and wasm-bindgen). Replace hanzi_lookup.js and hanzi_lookup_bg.wasm together in public/vendor/hanzi-lookup, preserving the wasm_bindgen(strokes) initialization and lookup(strokes, limit) API. HKIME loads these files dynamically through worker.js; no application relinking is required. Modified compatible versions may be substituted. Reverse engineering to debug modifications of this LGPL library is permitted. Clear browser caches or reload the local development server when replacing files.
